prompt: As of August 3 2024, which surviving building of the World's Columbian Exposition of 1893 sits on the same street as a skyscraper over 1,000 feet tall? Give the surviving building's current name.
answer:
The surviving building is the **Art Institute of Chicago**—originally the **World’s Congress Auxiliary Building**, constructed for the 1893 exposition.

It stands at **111 S. Michigan Avenue**, the same street as **875 N. Michigan Avenue** (formerly the John Hancock Center), which rises more than 1,000 feet.
